shell.toggleSidebar: Show or hide the side panel

home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: Prepare your requests, assemble them into scenarios and run them on demand.

errors.REQUEST_IN_USE: This request is used by scenarios.
errors.TOO_MANY_RUNS: Too many runs in progress. Try again shortly.

dialogs.deleteCollectionMessage: The collection and everything in it (requests, scenarios, environments and run history) will be deleted.
dialogs.requestInUseMessage: This request is used by the following scenarios. If you delete it, their steps will become orphaned.

variables.title: Variables
variables.name: Name
variables.keepSecret: Value saved — leave empty to keep it

problems.secretRenamed: Secret variable renamed: enter its value again

collectionSettings.title: Collection settings
collectionSettings.name: Collection name
collectionSettings.variablesHint: Default values, usable in every request. An environment can override them.
collectionSettings.authHint: Used by every request set to “Inherit from collection”.

environmentPage.title: Environment
environmentPage.name: Environment name
environmentPage.hint: Environment variables take precedence over collection variables.

requestPage.bodyIgnored: The body is not sent with GET or HEAD.

auth.inheritHint: The request uses the authentication defined in the collection settings.
auth.secretHint: For a secret, use a secret variable: its value stays encrypted and masked. For example:

assertions.evaluateHint: Evaluate the assertions against the displayed response
assertions.evaluateDisabled: Send the request first to get a response
assertions.empty: No assertions: the step succeeds if the HTTP status is 2xx.
assertions.notFound: Nothing found at this place in the response.

help.title: Assertions help
help.intro: An assertion compares part of the response with an expected value. The expected value may contain variables, for example:
help.noAssertion: Without assertions, a step succeeds as soon as the HTTP status is between 200 and 299.

status.label: HTTP status
status.description: The response status code, for example 200 or 404.

header.label: Header
header.description: The value of a response header (header names are case-insensitive).

jsonPath.label: JSON path
jsonPath.description: A value read from the JSON response body. Several matches give a list.

equals.label: equals
equals.description: Identical to the expected value (objects and lists are compared as JSON).

notEquals.label: does not equal
notEquals.description: Present and different from the expected value.

contains.label: contains
contains.description: The text contains the value, or the list contains this item.

exists.label: exists
exists.description: The target is present in the response (even if empty or null).

notExists.label: does not exist
notExists.description: The target is absent from the response.

matches.label: matches (regex)
matches.description: The text matches the regular expression.

isType.label: is of type
isType.description: JSON type: string, number, boolean, null, array or object.

jsonPath.index: The first item of a list (index 0)
jsonPath.last: The last item of a list
jsonPath.all: This field in every item (gives a list)
jsonPath.length: The number of items in a list
jsonPath.quoted: A name with spaces or special characters

stepErrors.CIRCULAR_VARIABLE: Variables referencing each other in a loop

response.title: Response
response.empty: Send the request to see its response.

extractions.title: Extractions
extractions.evaluateHint: Evaluate against the response of the request's last send
extractions.help: An extraction stores a value from the response in a run variable, usable by the following steps. In a parallel group, it is only visible once the group has finished.
extractions.noSend: Send the request from its editor first to be able to evaluate.

modeHints.sequential: Steps run one after another, in order.
modeHints.parallel: Steps run at the same time, up to the maximum concurrency.

scenarioEditor.stopOnFailureHint: On: as soon as a step fails, the next ones are skipped (in parallel, steps already started still finish).

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.hint: Values specific to this step, replacing those of the request or of the variables.

scenarioEditor.dropHere: Drag a request here, or use the + button
scenarioEditor.dragHint: Tip: drag requests from the left panel into a group, and reorder steps with their handle.

scenarioRun.noResult: No result for this step yet.
scenarioRun.parametersHint: Values valid for this run only; they take precedence over the environment and the collection.
scenarioRun.launchHint: Saves the scenario, then starts a run
scenarioRun.selectStep: Click a step to see its result.

scenarioIssues.CONFLICTING_PARALLEL_EXTRACTION: Another branch of this parallel group also extracts the variable “{{ detail }}”.
scenarioIssues.ORPHAN_STEP: The request of this step has been deleted.
scenarioIssues.UNDEFINED_VARIABLE: The variable “{{ detail }}” is not defined anywhere at this point (it may come from a run parameter).

history.title: History
history.retention: Unpinned runs are deleted automatically after 30 days.
history.snapshotHint: The scenario as it was run (snapshot), even if it has changed since.
